basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: A request, hold and confirmation lifecycle for scarce or scheduled capacity.
Differs from a ticket, which is evidence of an entitlement to use the capacity.
Differs from an appointment or calendar event, which records time but not commercial terms.
Keeps confirmation, payment, ticketing, check-in and fulfilment states apart.

may: Search availability and draft a reservation request.
Place a provisional hold within delegated limits.
Notify travellers or guests of changes.
mustNot: Commit scarce capacity or accept terms without approval.
requiresHuman: Confirming a booking with financial commitment.
Transferring a reservation to another person.

considerations: Itineraries reveal location and movement of people, a safety issue.
Accessibility needs and special requests are sensitive data.
Overbooking practices can harm vulnerable travellers.

items: A reservation names a provider, a beneficiary, a reserved resource, a time and place and a status.
Often confused with a ticket, an invoice, an appointment or an order.
IATA passenger name record and NDC standards.
ISO 4217 currency codes and ISO 8601 dates.
